programme.title: Journey Home
programme.desc:
Mark DeYoung came from a Nazarene family, and was heavily involved in church. He went on to attend Trevecca Nazarene in Nashville, and then began work at a Christian music station, where he also hosted the morning show.
During this time, he experienced some major challenges to his personal faith. When he began to rediscover it, it lead him to seminary studies, and eventually on staff at a seeker-friendly church.
The toxicity he experienced there led him to leave ministry altogether, and wonder if he’d ever fit in at any church. After wrestling with alcohol, he realized he needed an anchor of stability that would align his faith and his personal life. Discovering Catholic media, he began to finally get real answers, and realized that his true spiritual home was in the Catholic Church.

programme.title: Journey Home
programme.sub-title: Deacon Cary Klivan - Convert from Judaism
programme.desc:
Cary Klivan grew up Jewish in Brooklyn, and though he was culturally observant, he was spiritually agnostic, more along the lines of scientific materialism.
He ended up marrying his childhood sweetheart, who happened to be one of the few Catholics in his neighborhood. He agreed to raise his children Catholic, because to him faith was just a cultural marker.
The reality of becoming a father, however, got him asking deeper philosophical and spiritual questions. He began to see that the stories he learned in his Jewish background came to life anew in fulfilled form in Jesus, and suddenly, he found himself not only believing, but desiring to be baptized and serve the Church as a Permanent Deacon.

programme.title: Journey Home
programme.sub-title: Deacon Cary Klivan - Convert from Judaism
programme.desc:
Cary Klivan grew up Jewish in Brooklyn, and though he was culturally observant, he was spiritually agnostic, more along the lines of scientific materialism.
He ended up marrying his childhood sweetheart, who happened to be one of the few Catholics in his neighborhood. He agreed to raise his children Catholic, because to him faith was just a cultural marker.
The reality of becoming a father, however, got him asking deeper philosophical and spiritual questions. He began to see that the stories he learned in his Jewish background came to life anew in fulfilled form in Jesus, and suddenly, he found himself not only believing, but desiring to be baptized and serve the Church as a Permanent Deacon.

programme.title: Journey Home
programme.desc:
Mark DeYoung came from a Nazarene family, and was heavily involved in church. He went on to attend Trevecca Nazarene in Nashville, and then began work at a Christian music station, where he also hosted the morning show.
During this time, he experienced some major challenges to his personal faith. When he began to rediscover it, it lead him to seminary studies, and eventually on staff at a seeker-friendly church.
The toxicity he experienced there led him to leave ministry altogether, and wonder if he’d ever fit in at any church. After wrestling with alcohol, he realized he needed an anchor of stability that would align his faith and his personal life. Discovering Catholic media, he began to finally get real answers, and realized that his true spiritual home was in the Catholic Church.

programme.title: Journey Home
programme.sub-title: Deacon Cary Klivan - Convert from Judaism
programme.desc:
Cary Klivan grew up Jewish in Brooklyn, and though he was culturally observant, he was spiritually agnostic, more along the lines of scientific materialism.
He ended up marrying his childhood sweetheart, who happened to be one of the few Catholics in his neighborhood. He agreed to raise his children Catholic, because to him faith was just a cultural marker.
The reality of becoming a father, however, got him asking deeper philosophical and spiritual questions. He began to see that the stories he learned in his Jewish background came to life anew in fulfilled form in Jesus, and suddenly, he found himself not only believing, but desiring to be baptized and serve the Church as a Permanent Deacon.

programme.title: Journey Home
programme.sub-title: Deacon Cary Klivan - Convert from Judaism
programme.desc:
Cary Klivan grew up Jewish in Brooklyn, and though he was culturally observant, he was spiritually agnostic, more along the lines of scientific materialism.
He ended up marrying his childhood sweetheart, who happened to be one of the few Catholics in his neighborhood. He agreed to raise his children Catholic, because to him faith was just a cultural marker.
The reality of becoming a father, however, got him asking deeper philosophical and spiritual questions. He began to see that the stories he learned in his Jewish background came to life anew in fulfilled form in Jesus, and suddenly, he found himself not only believing, but desiring to be baptized and serve the Church as a Permanent Deacon.

programme.title: Journey Home
programme.sub-title: Deacon Cary Klivan - Convert from Judaism
programme.desc:
Cary Klivan grew up Jewish in Brooklyn, and though he was culturally observant, he was spiritually agnostic, more along the lines of scientific materialism.
He ended up marrying his childhood sweetheart, who happened to be one of the few Catholics in his neighborhood. He agreed to raise his children Catholic, because to him faith was just a cultural marker.
The reality of becoming a father, however, got him asking deeper philosophical and spiritual questions. He began to see that the stories he learned in his Jewish background came to life anew in fulfilled form in Jesus, and suddenly, he found himself not only believing, but desiring to be baptized and serve the Church as a Permanent Deacon.

programme.sub-title: Deacon Cary Klivan - Convert from Judaism
programme.desc:
Cary Klivan grew up Jewish in Brooklyn, and though he was culturally observant, he was spiritually agnostic, more along the lines of scientific materialism.
He ended up marrying his childhood sweetheart, who happened to be one of the few Catholics in his neighborhood. He agreed to raise his children Catholic, because to him faith was just a cultural marker.
The reality of becoming a father, however, got him asking deeper philosophical and spiritual questions. He began to see that the stories he learned in his Jewish background came to life anew in fulfilled form in Jesus, and suddenly, he found himself not only believing, but desiring to be baptized and serve the Church as a Permanent Deacon.

programme.title: Perou : Les Huit Meres
programme.desc: Au début des années 1980, une organisation révolutionnaire communiste appelée Sendero Luminoso – Sentier lumineux – a lancé une opération terroriste brutale dans les régions rurales des Andes péruviennes, utilisant la terreur sans pitié. L'armée envoyée pour combattre le groupe terroriste a également fait un usage excessif de la force, détruisant des villages et tuant de nombreux civils innocents. En 2003, à la fin de 20 ans d'insurrection, plus de 70 000 personnes étaient mortes ou avaient disparu. Encore aujourd'hui, les traumatismes occasionnés par ce conflit affectent profondément la vie quotidienne du peuple péruvien. La Congrégation des Sœurs missionnaires de Jésus Verbe et Victime apporte soins et réconfort à ces régions éloignées.

programme.title: Journey Home
programme.sub-title: Deacon Cary Klivan - Convert from Judaism
programme.desc:
Cary Klivan grew up Jewish in Brooklyn, and though he was culturally observant, he was spiritually agnostic, more along the lines of scientific materialism.
He ended up marrying his childhood sweetheart, who happened to be one of the few Catholics in his neighborhood. He agreed to raise his children Catholic, because to him faith was just a cultural marker.
The reality of becoming a father, however, got him asking deeper philosophical and spiritual questions. He began to see that the stories he learned in his Jewish background came to life anew in fulfilled form in Jesus, and suddenly, he found himself not only believing, but desiring to be baptized and serve the Church as a Permanent Deacon.

programme.title: Journey Home
programme.sub-title: Deacon Cary Klivan - Convert from Judaism
programme.desc:
Cary Klivan grew up Jewish in Brooklyn, and though he was culturally observant, he was spiritually agnostic, more along the lines of scientific materialism.
He ended up marrying his childhood sweetheart, who happened to be one of the few Catholics in his neighborhood. He agreed to raise his children Catholic, because to him faith was just a cultural marker.
The reality of becoming a father, however, got him asking deeper philosophical and spiritual questions. He began to see that the stories he learned in his Jewish background came to life anew in fulfilled form in Jesus, and suddenly, he found himself not only believing, but desiring to be baptized and serve the Church as a Permanent Deacon.

programme.title: Journey Home
programme.sub-title: Deacon Cary Klivan - Convert from Judaism
programme.desc:
Cary Klivan grew up Jewish in Brooklyn, and though he was culturally observant, he was spiritually agnostic, more along the lines of scientific materialism.
He ended up marrying his childhood sweetheart, who happened to be one of the few Catholics in his neighborhood. He agreed to raise his children Catholic, because to him faith was just a cultural marker.
The reality of becoming a father, however, got him asking deeper philosophical and spiritual questions. He began to see that the stories he learned in his Jewish background came to life anew in fulfilled form in Jesus, and suddenly, he found himself not only believing, but desiring to be baptized and serve the Church as a Permanent Deacon.

programme.desc: Nacido en Lima, Perú, Luis Enrique Ascoy inicia su servicio musical como solista ofreciendo recitales a guitarra y voz en muchas parroquias y colegios de Lima en 1986. Junto a su esposa, fundaron en 1989 Producciones Tenax y en el año 2007, el proyecto Pescando en Red. Ha grabado más de veinte producciones musicales y ha escrito tres libros. Ha recorrido todo el Perú y gran parte de América Latina, habiendo compartido escenario con músicos católicos de la talla de Martín Valverde, Daniel Poli, Ziza Fernandez, Kiki Troia, Alfareros, entre otros. Sus temas se caracterizan por sus rimas, metáforas, poesía y claridad profética, los que han valido la admiración del público creyente y no creyente de toda América Latina, España y los EEUU.

A partir de ese momento, se han dedicado a la evangelización, especialmente de matrimonios. Pertenecen a la Comunidad Siervos de Cristo Vivo, fundada por el sacerdote canadiense Emiliano Tardif, M.S.C. Son dominicanos y residen en la ciudad de Santo Domingo.

programme.title: Mientras el mundo gira
programme.desc: El muro de enemistad, el muro de los miedos, el muro de la comodidad…esos son los muros que debemos de derribar. Con Jesucristo podemos vencer todo. ¡Él venció la muerte! El Padre Willie expone la realidad del sentir de hoy en día de las personas que han puesto un muro en sus vidas y nos anima a derribarlos.

programme.title: Conozca primero su fe católica

programme.desc: El problema de las pandillas juveniles en Centroamérica ha captado la atención internacional debido a su magnitud, no solo en estos países, sino en todo el continente. programme.sub-title: El Papa León XIV y el corazón católico de Francia
programme.desc: Esta semana en Vaticano: repasamos los momentos más destacados del histórico viaje del Papa León XIV a Francia y conversamos con el embajador de Francia ante la Santa Sede sobre la historia y la situación actual de la fe en el país. Visitamos también la réplica de la Gruta de Lourdes en los Jardines Vaticanos y descubrimos la iglesia de Santa María in Via, conocida también como el «Lourdes secreto de Roma».

programme.title: Ángelus con el Papa León XIV
programme.desc: El Papa León XIV reza el Ángelus desde Roma. Esta oración especial, acompañada del toque de la campana del Ángelus, conmemora la Encarnación de Cristo.

programme.title: Nuestra fe en vivo
programme.desc: Nacido en Lima, Perú, Luis Enrique Ascoy inicia su servicio musical como solista ofreciendo recitales a guitarra y voz en muchas parroquias y colegios de Lima en 1986. Junto a su esposa, fundaron en 1989 Producciones Tenax y en el año 2007, el proyecto Pescando en Red. Ha grabado más de veinte producciones musicales y ha escrito tres libros. Ha recorrido todo el Perú y gran parte de América Latina, habiendo compartido escenario con músicos católicos de la talla de Martín Valverde, Daniel Poli, Ziza Fernandez, Kiki Troia, Alfareros, entre otros. Sus temas se caracterizan por sus rimas, metáforas, poesía y claridad profética, los que han valido la admiración del público creyente y no creyente de toda América Latina, España y los EEUU.

programme.title: Informe provida
programme.sub-title: Protección a niños - La lucha contra la trata infantil
programme.desc: La trata infantil es una de las formas más graves de violencia contra los niños y una realidad que continúa afectando a miles de menores. En este programa abordamos los peligros de la explotación y la trata infantil, así como la importancia de proteger a los niños, reconocer las señales de alerta y fortalecer los esfuerzos de prevención y defensa de la infancia.

programme.title: Misa solemne de San Francisco de Asís
programme.desc: Misa Solemne de San Francisco, presidida por los dominicos en la Iglesia de San Salvador, en Jerusalén.

programme.title: Mientras el mundo gira
programme.desc: El muro de enemistad, el muro de los miedos, el muro de la comodidad…esos son los muros que debemos de derribar. Con Jesucristo podemos vencer todo. ¡Él venció la muerte! El Padre Willie expone la realidad del sentir de hoy en día de las personas que han puesto un muro en sus vidas y nos anima a derribarlos.

programme.title: Conozca primero su fe católica
programme.desc: El Padre Pedro nos recuerda que mientras haya vida hay esperanza. Y esa esperanza está en el creer.. creer en ese Dios que nos creó y que nos ama con amor infinito y eterno y está esperándonos siempre con los brazos abiertos. Además, responde a las preguntas llegadas al programa vía telefónica, el correo electrónico (padrepedro@ewtn.com) y Facebook (www.facebook.com/ppedronunez).

programme.title: Perspectiva Católica
programme.desc: ¿Está reñido el seguimiento de Cristo con la búsqueda de mayores beneficios económicos? ¿Es incompatible la posesión de bienes con el consejo evangélico de la pobreza? Los esposos y emprendedores Carlos Galeano y Valentina Osorio nos ayudan a encontrar respuestas.

programme.title: Donde Dios llora
programme.sub-title: El impacto de la violencia intrafamiliar en las pandillas de Nicaragua
programme.desc: El problema de las pandillas juveniles en Centroamérica ha captado la atención internacional debido a su magnitud, no solo en estos países, sino en todo el continente. Muchos factores conocidos impulsan el reclutamiento de pandillas, en particular la pobreza y la frustración juvenil. Sin embargo, un factor menos conocido, pero principal, es el ciclo de violencia intrafamiliar, en particular el abuso infantil, que empuja a los jóvenes a las pandillas.

programme.desc: El problema de las pandillas juveniles en Centroamérica ha captado la atención internacional debido a su magnitud, no solo en estos países, sino en todo el continente. Muchos factores conocidos impulsan el reclutamiento de pandillas, en particular la pobreza y la frustración juvenil. Sin embargo, un factor menos conocido, pero principal, es el ciclo de violencia intrafamiliar, en particular el abuso infantil, que empuja a los jóvenes a las pandillas.

programme.desc: La reina Esther hizo cosas maravillosas a través de la palabra de Dios. Es considerada como una heroína máxima en el pueblo hebreo. Además, se celebra una vez por año su epopeya.
